$comment: MY FM playlist. SHIPS EMPTY ON PURPOSE — this build bundles no music.
Add only files you have the right to use, drop them in assets/audio/tracks/,
and give every one of them a real licence line. See assets/audio/README.md
for the how-to and assets/audio/ATTRIBUTION.md for the rules.
title   (required) what the radio panel shows
license (required) the exact licence, e.g. 'CC BY 4.0', 'CC0 1.0',
source  (recommended) the URL you got it from
Entries missing `file` are ignored. Files that will not load are skipped
with a single console warning — the station never spams the log.
